head: codex/74-stale-claim-topology-regression
title: [v0.92][C-SDLC v2] Fix same-issue stale topology bind regression
body:
Closes #74

## Summary
- skips stale same-issue projections that declare neither branch nor worktree topology before current-schema decoding
- preserves strict failure for malformed, partial, and genuine ownership topology
- adds real-binary coverage for the reported same-issue legacy claim projection without mutating stale records

## Validation
- `cargo test --locked --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --test gate2` (5 passed)
- `cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- `cargo fmt --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml -- --check`
- typed issue validation and diff hygiene

## Review
Independent exact-head review passed with no actionable findings.
